title: Taiwanese Association of the Greater Salt Lake 大鹽湖 區台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese Association of the Greater Salt Lake (TAGSL) is a chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization of Taiwanese American community associations. TAGSL serves the Taiwanese American community in the Greater Salt Lake area of Utah and is listed under the TAA Western region.
